infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Kwill uses speech recognition to turn your voice into text in your thesis.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Kwill uses your microphone to dictate text into your thesis.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Kwill uses the camera to let you take a photo and insert it into your thesis document — for example, photographing a printed chart, a lab result, or handwritten notes to add as a figure in a chapter.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Kwill uses your photo library to let you choose images to insert into your thesis document or attach to the AI assistant — for example, selecting a graph or diagram from your photos to add as a figure in a chapter.
